Who We Are

A Community Rooted in Possibility

We believe every student, regardless of background, deserves a chance to understand and shape the AI-driven future.

InspireSaplingAI is a volunteer-driven non-profit founded by educators, researchers, and technologists who share a single conviction: AI literacy is a civic necessity, not a luxury.

We develop open-access curricula, host community workshops, and mentor young learners from underrepresented backgrounds — giving them the tools to engage critically and creatively with artificial intelligence.

Like a sapling, every mind we reach has the potential to grow into something that shapes the world around it. Our job is to provide the sunlight, water, and soil.

Our Approach

The Problem & Our Solution

AI is reshaping every corner of society — but access to AI education remains deeply unequal.

The Challenge

  • AI tools are rapidly entering classrooms, yet most teachers have no training to guide students through them.
  • Existing AI education resources are fragmented, expensive, or inaccessible to under-resourced schools.
  • Students from low-income and minority communities are disproportionately excluded from the AI economy.
  • Without early exposure, the next generation risks becoming passive consumers of AI rather than informed participants.

Our Solution

  • We create free, standards-aligned AI curricula openly licensed for any school or educator to use.
  • Our volunteer network delivers hands-on workshops directly in under-resourced communities.
  • We offer mentorship programs pairing students with AI professionals from diverse backgrounds.
  • We advocate for equitable AI literacy policies at the district and state level.

Help a Sapling Grow

Your support — whether as a donor or volunteer — directly funds free AI workshops, open curricula, and mentorship for students who need it most. Every contribution plants a new seed.
